article-gender.label: Article & Noun Gender
article-gender.description: Confusion between masculine (der), feminine (die), and neuter (das).
article-gender.rationale: Noun gender in German is grammatical and must be memorized with the definite article and plural form.

case.label: Case Endings (Nom/Akk/Dat/Gen)
case.description: Incorrect case form applied to articles, adjectives, or pronouns.
case.rationale: Cases identify sentence roles: Nominative (subject), Accusative (direct object), Dative (indirect object), Genitive (possession).

verb-position.label: Verb Position (V2 / Verb-End)
verb-position.description: Placing the conjugated verb in an incorrect syntactic slot.
verb-position.rationale: Main clauses enforce verb in position 2 (V2). Subordinate clauses introduced by subordinating conjunctions force the verb to the clause end.

conjugation.label: Verb Conjugation
conjugation.description: Mismatch between subject person/number and verb ending.
conjugation.rationale: Verbs must agree with their subject in person and number across irregular stem changes.

tense.label: Tense (Perfekt / Präteritum)
tense.description: Incorrect auxiliary (haben vs sein) or wrong participle form.
tense.rationale: Spoken German relies heavily on Perfekt with 'haben' or 'sein' (for motion/change of state).

preposition.label: Prepositions & Cases
preposition.description: Wrong preposition choice or incorrect governing case.
preposition.rationale: Prepositions govern specific cases: fixed cases (akk/dat/gen) or two-way (Wechselpräpositionen: accusative for motion, dative for location).

word-order.label: Word Order (TeKaMoLo)
word-order.description: Misordering adverbial phrases or sentence constituents.
word-order.rationale: Standard adverbial sequencing follows Temporal (when), Causal (why), Modal (how), and Lokativ (where).

connector.label: Conjunctions & Connectors
connector.description: Improper connector choice or failure to apply correct word order following it.
connector.rationale: Coordinating conjunctions (ADUSO) take position 0; subordinating conjunctions push the verb to the end; adverbial connectors take position 1 and invert the subject.

spelling.label: Orthography & Spelling
spelling.description: Misspelled headwords, missing capital letters on nouns, or missed umlauts.
spelling.rationale: All German nouns are capitalized; umlauts (ä, ö, ü) and ß alter pronunciation and meaning.

vocabulary.label: Vocabulary Selection
vocabulary.description: False friends or inexact word choice.
vocabulary.rationale: Select exact register and idiomatic German expressions rather than literal native-language calques.

comprehension-keyword-trap.label: Comprehension: Keyword Trap
comprehension-keyword-trap.description: Selecting an option because a surface word matched without verifying sentence context.
comprehension-keyword-trap.rationale: Exam distractors intentionally repeat passage keywords in contradictory statements.

comprehension-negation.label: Comprehension: Negation Trap
comprehension-negation.rationale: Pay careful attention to negation operators which invert the truth value of the statement.

comprehension-detail.label: Comprehension: Detail Matching
comprehension-detail.description: Failing to verify precise times, places, conditions, or quantities.
comprehension-detail.rationale: Scan supporting evidence spans to confirm that details align with the question.
